messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's current action to lowering their head and resting one hand on their forehead, following the demonstrated action in the motion reference. Transfer only the demonstrated action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please select video 0, then use that video as the starting point for the following change: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's current action to lowering their head and resting one hand on their forehead, following the demonstration in the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The figure stands in the center of a large room, then turns and raises his hand to his forehead in a salute before lowering it and standing with his hand on his hip.","camera":"A full-body shot that slowly orbits around the figure, changing the background perspective from front to side to back.","clothing":"A dark, long-sleeved military-style uniform with a high collar, gold buttons, a belt, and a red emblem on the chest.","hair_color":"White.","hairstyle":"Short, swept-back hair.","identity":"A 3D animated male figure with a slim build, dark skin, and a short beard.","scene":"A spacious, futuristic interior with a polished reflective floor, large glass windows, and glowing blue and pink neon architectural elements."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output keeps the same character, uniform, futuristic scene, and orbiting full-body camera. The character now turns, raises a hand to the forehead/head area, lowers the head, and then stands with a hand on the hip, matching the reference motion more closely than the source's standing/turning action.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to lowering their head and resting one hand on their forehead, following the motion reference, while preserving identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
uncertain: Whether the hand is precisely on the forehead in every relevant frame or sometimes near the head/face.
unexpected_changes: The output frames appear slightly cropped or letterboxed compared with the source frames.
